hero.eyebrow: Independent land search · Los Lagos & Patagonia
hero.title: Find your place in Patagonia.
hero.lead: Patagonia Land Hunter is LAND ADVISORS' active search service: we define where and what to look for, shortlist options with local criteria, and stay with you through the purchase — with no inventory of our own to sell.
hero.ctaPrimary: Tell us what you're looking for
what.label: Patagonia Land Hunter
what.title: We don't sell land. We find it for you.
what.lead: We work exclusively for the buyer. We're not a brokerage or listing portal — we have no plots of our own to push.
what.body: Many buyers — in Chile and abroad — know what they want but not which area to focus on, which questions to ask, or how to compare options side by side. This service organizes that path.
includes.label: What may be included
includes.title: A focused search with clear deliverables
includes.lead: Every engagement is tailored to your goal. Typical pieces of Patagonia Land Hunter:
includes.item1: Search brief: goal, budget, size, access, connectivity, land use and timeline
includes.item2: Target areas in Los Lagos and/or Patagonia — plus clear filters to rule out mismatched zones
includes.item3: Active search across public listings, local networks and off-market contacts
includes.item4: Curated shortlist: a few strong options, not a dump of mass listings
includes.item5: Preliminary on-the-ground review: access, surroundings, connectivity, red flags and key questions before you make an offer
includes.item6: Site-visit coordination and joint tours when it makes sense
includes.item7: Help comparing options and preparing to negotiate
includes.item8: Coordination with lawyers, brokers and technical pros — without replacing their reports
includes.disclaimer: LAND ADVISORS does not replace legal advice, title review, survey, environmental or engineering studies. When needed, we help you hire those services before closing.
includes.risk.title: Lowering legal and practical risk
includes.risk.body: Buying land in Chile means zoning, subdivision rules, services, access and paperwork that change by municipality. Our job is to keep you moving in order: what to review, when, and with whom — before you commit capital.
why.label: Where we work
why.title: Two regions, different kinds of opportunity
why.lead: We run this service in Los Lagos and Chilean Patagonia — with local presence, field work and contact networks.
why.note: There is no single "best area". There is an area that fits your goal, budget and how you plan to use the land.
zone.lagos.title: Los Lagos Region
zone.lagos.text: Lago Llanquihue basin, Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue and the rural fringe: nature, services, flights from Santiago and quality of life. A strong fit if you want landscape and access in balance.
zone.lagos.bullet2: Services, connectivity and town life nearby
zone.lagos.bullet3: Second home, family project or long-term investment
zone.patagonia.title: Patagonia
zone.patagonia.text: From northern Patagonia to more remote ground: big landscapes, privacy, lifestyle projects, conservation or tourism with a long horizon.
process.label: How we help
process.title: Six things you shouldn't handle alone from abroad
process.lead: Buying land in Chile from overseas has steps most buyers prefer to hand off — always with local judgment and clear communication.
step1.title: The right properties
step1.text: We find options that fit your brief through partner brokers and trusted local contacts — not a mass listing dump.
step2.title: Area guidance
step2.text: We help you see which areas make sense for your goal, budget and how you plan to use the land.
step3.title: Legal checks
step3.text: We line up what to review and with whom — titles, easements and paperwork — before you commit capital.
step4.title: Zoning and subdivisions
step4.text: Early read of local rules: what you can build, how the lot is divided and early warning signs.
step5.title: Negotiation support
step5.text: We compare options, prep your position and support you in negotiation with market and local context.
step6.title: Lawyers and notaries
step6.text: Coordination with Chilean professionals through closing. We don't replace their advice — we help you move in order.
intl.label: International buyers

intl.lead: Buying land in Chile from abroad needs boots on the ground, local judgment and someone who can visit and filter before you fly in.
intl.eyes: LAND ADVISORS can be your eyes on the ground in Southern Chile.
intl.partners.title: Working with international partners
intl.partners.text: We partner with real estate advisors who already have a client interested in Chile — we act as the local land partner while you keep the client relationship.
